When I was seven I asked my dad for help with my homework and he laughed and said I should already know it. I still feel that as a heat in my face. Somewhere back then I decided that needing help makes me a burden, so now I expect that if I ask for something, people will be annoyed with me. At work today my manager asked how the project was going and I froze; being asked felt like being found out. Afterwards I lay awake ruminating, and the more I ruminated the tighter my chest got. When my chest gets that tight I go for a walk, and walking quiets the rumination for a while.
